title: Calcium Carbonate
description: High-purity calcium carbonate (CaCO3) — ground calcium carbonate (GCC) and precipitated calcium carbonate (PCC) for construction, plastics, paints, food, and industrial applications in Oman.

details.longDescription: Calcium Carbonate (CaCO3) supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies high-purity calcium carbonate to construction, plastics, paint, food processing, and industrial customers across Muscat and Oman. Calcium carbonate is one of the most widely used industrial minerals globally, and demand in Oman is driven by the construction boom, expanding food processing sector, and growing plastics and rubber manufacturing. We supply two primary forms: Ground Calcium Carbonate (GCC), produced by mechanical grinding of limestone or marble, available in multiple particle sizes from coarse powder to ultrafine (<2 micron) grades for different applications; and Precipitated Calcium Carbonate (PCC), chemically produced for higher purity and more controlled particle morphology, used in high-specification applications such as food, pharmaceuticals, and specialty coatings. Applications in Oman include construction and building materials (mortar filler, concrete aggregate, road base), plastics compounding (filler and functional additive in PVC, polyolefins, and rubber — up to 60% loading), paint and coatings (extender pigment — reduces TiO2 requirement), food-grade (E170 — calcium supplement, food fortification, anti-caking), water treatment (pH neutralisation, lime softening), paper manufacturing, and animal feed calcium supplementation. Global Chemicals LLC supplies calcium carbonate in 25kg bags, 500kg and 1,000kg super sacks, and bulk quantities. Technical grades from 98% CaCO3 content; food-grade (E170) available with food safety documentation.
